scenario.name: Wyrmling Lair
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) boss encounter: four Level 5 adventurers (Fighter, Wizard, Cleric, Rogue) battle a Red Dragon Wyrmling, two Cinder Hounds (one held back), and an Ember Magmin—all fire-immune—testing damage-immunity awareness, breath-weapon spacing, Bless + Shield economy, Vex + Nick mastery combos, and multi-round focus fire.

actions.rationale: The Ember Magmin is 75 ft away, inside shortbow normal range (80 ft). Piercing damage ignores the fire immunity, and I can shoot without advancing into the enemy group.
actions.table_talk: Softening up the Magmin from range. Hold the line and let them come to us.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Shortbow (23 vs AC 14) for 8 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: The action is spent on the shortbow shot, and the offhand attack isn't usable because no light weapon attack was made. No enemies are in reach, so repositioning provokes nothing. Falling back 5 ft toward Dorian and Lyra adds distance from the fire-immune enemies, which gives me more ranged shots as they close. It also keeps me out of a single breath-weapon cone with the casters.
actions.table_talk: Falling back toward the line. Let them come to us.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper moves 5 ft to (5, 20).

actions.rationale: The action is spent on the shortbow shot, so the offhand attack isn't legal because no light melee weapon attack was made. Kaelen has already repositioned near the party line, and the nearest enemies are 20+ ft away. Ending the turn.
actions.table_talk: Magmin's bloodied, everything here is fire-immune, so use non-fire damage. I'm holding at the line.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Cinder Hound is 25 ft away, inside the javelin's 30 ft normal range. Piercing damage avoids fire immunity, and Slow mastery cuts its speed by 10 ft as it closes on us. This also lets Aldric hold the line instead of advancing alone.
actions.table_talk: Javelin out at the lead hound, slowing it. Hold the line, everyone.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Cinder Hound with Javelin (9 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: Extra Attack gives one more attack this turn. The lead hound is 25 ft away, inside javelin range, and piercing damage ignores fire immunity. A hit also applies Slow mastery.
actions.table_talk: Second javelin at the lead hound. Hold the line.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Cinder Hound with Javelin (13 vs AC 15).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and no bonus actions are available. I'm isolated at (0,0), so I'll move up as the front line in front of Dorian and Kaelen. That keeps the group tight against the fast hounds and the wyrmling.
actions.table_talk: Falling back to the line in front of Dorian. Let them come to us.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance moves 15 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Action is spent and attacks are used up. Aldric has already thrown two javelins and fallen back to the line in front of Dorian. No bonus action options are available, so I'm ending the turn and letting the enemies come to us.
actions.table_talk: Holding the line in front of Dorian. Fire-immune enemies, so use non-fire damage.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 4 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling moves 15 ft to (15, 15).
Kaelen Whisper saves against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 13 damage.
Aldric Vance fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 26 damage.
Lyra Starweave fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 26 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 26 damage.
Round 1: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 4 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 10 ft to (15, 10).
Kaelen Whisper saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
Aldric Vance saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
Lyra Starweave drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Lyra Starweave fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 21 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
Round 1: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 3 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B moves 40 ft to (10, 20).
Kaelen Whisper saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 5 damage.
Aldric Vance drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Aldric Vance fails against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Dorian Dawnshield fails against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
Round 1: Ember Magmin's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Closing to melee reach of Kaelen Whisper.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin moves 15 ft to (10, 20).

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Touch.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin hits Kaelen Whisper with Touch (24 vs AC 16) for 11 damage.
Kaelen Whisper drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
